## Synopsis

Validates each manifest locally, then uploads it. Installing a name that exists
updates that server in place, and a paused server takes the new manifest and stays
paused until strazactl apps enable. Each file prints one line with the runtime, the
health and, when one follows, the next command to run.

```
strazactl apps install -f <path>... [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  strazactl apps install -f scout-tools.yaml
```

## Options

```
  -f, --file path   the path of an MCP server's App manifest (repeatable)
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
